Commuter100Block-149730.description: This meal plan is available to students living in off-campus housing, resident advisors, and Grace Street Apartment residents. The 2026-2027 Off Campus 100 Block Plan provides 100 swipes per semester for entry to all-you-care-to-eat residential dining rooms, or to purchase Duke Deals at most retail locations (limited to 2 Duke Deals per day). $350 Dining Dollars per semester to use at on-campus dining locations, convenience stores, concessions, and vending machines. Use punches to treat guests.
Commuter100Block-149730.name: Off Campus 100 Block (2026-27)
Commuter100Block-149730.additional_info: The price reflected is the per semester rate. This meal plan is an annual contract billed over two semesters. You will be charged once in the fall and again in the spring. Purchases made with Dining Dollars are exempt from Harrisonburg meals/sales tax (12.3%). Unused Dining Dollars roll over from fall to semester but expire at the end of the semester Meal plan swipes do not work during university breaks, dining dollars are accepted.
Commuter100Block-149730.extra_info: Unused Dining Dollars roll over to the semester
Commuter100Block-149730.guest_punches: Use punches to treat your friends.
